units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:6">Sot. VIII, 6</cite> <he>שתחלת נ׳ נפילה</he>, corrected <cite ref="Sotah 44b:6">ib. 44ᵇ</cite> (as in Y. ed.) <he>שתחלת נפילה נ׳</he> for the beginning of falling (in slaughter) is the rout; Y. ib. VIII, end, 23ᵃ; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 198:1">Sifré Deut. 198</cite> <he>שתחלת נ׳ נפילה</he> for the beginning of flight means falling.
